title: ABOUT US
heading:
CK TOOL
OKE's Korean subsidiary
text: OKE founded in 1996 is total cutting tool maker producing all carbide products and not only listed on china stock exchange in 2020 but also aggressive investment has consolidated its position in the cutting tool market. Now we have just completed 3 plants and equipped over 300 pcs flute machines so they can produce up to 12 million pcs of solid endmills and drills per year.
